deviations.reason: Ran bash .claude/scripts/deploy-headless.sh once during Phase 3 (not deferred entirely to Phase 6) so the test suite exercises the real widened script. This also surfaced an unrelated doc-lint FAIL (Phase 2's two new files were missing from core's manifest.json provides.scripts list); fixed by adding both entries to agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json, re-deployed, and verify-deploy.sh now reports 33/33 PASS. Phase 6 will still run the final full deploy + gate + acceptance checks as planned; this interim deploy is idempotent and does not change that.
